limitations.metric_basis: task metrics are summed once per unique (stage, stage attempt, task id)
limitations.time_semantics: executor_run_time_ms and executor_cpu_time_ns are summed task work, not wall-clock time
limitations.shared_stages: a stage attempt is assigned from StageSubmitted job group when available; otherwise the stage is assigned to its first profile
limitations.jvm_gc_time: JVM GC time is reported per task and may overlap across concurrently running tasks
limitations.truncated_final_line: a malformed or truncated JSON line marks the log incomplete
